ui-sharing.isolationCaveat: The isolation has a gap: each visiting conversation is its own session, but they share this agent's workspace, so a file one conversation writes there can be read by another. The other conversations' records sit in the profile's config folder; on Claude Code read-deny rules keep them out, and when Bash is allowed it also depends on auto mode's judgement. When serving outsiders, limit the tools to read-only ones (Read, Grep, Glob), or give it a workspace and profile of its own.
